title: Construction of the model for predicting prognosis by key genes regulating EGFR-TKI resistance.
summary: Machine-learning models identified genes associated with EGFR-TKI resistance and predicted lung-adenocarcinoma prognosis; resistance biology and clinical utility remain candidate-level. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
